content.user_title: Research Projects with Parallel Specialist Agents
content.value_statement: Early project decisions often rely on incomplete technical and market evidence. This skill coordinates specialist agents and combines sourced findings into a structured research report.
actual_capabilities: Parses a project description and selects quick, standard, or deep research depth.
Reviews available project context before asking for missing goals, users, preferences, and constraints.
Dispatches specialist agents for technology, architecture, market, and optional user experience research.
Uses Context7 when available and supports research without Context7 when requested.
Checks agent results for sources, relevance, formatting, and contradictions before synthesis.
Creates a dated Markdown report or returns the result in the terminal.
limitations: Research quality depends on available sources and the accuracy of specialist agent results.
Context7 research requires an installed Context7 MCP integration.
The skill does not modify code or implement its recommendations.
Recommendations require human review before project commitments or purchasing decisions.

use_cases.title: Compare Technology Stacks
use_cases.description: Evaluate primary and alternative technology combinations with compatibility, adoption, and maintenance evidence.
use_cases.target_user: Engineering leads planning a new product

use_cases.title: Map Competitive Products
use_cases.description: Compare competitors, identify positioning gaps, and connect market findings to product requirements.

use_cases.title: Validate Architecture Direction
use_cases.description: Research architecture patterns and test their fit with the preferred technology stack and project constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Quick Survey
prompt_templates.prompt: /team-research Research a task management application for small agencies using --quick.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for an initial comparison with the core researchers.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Defined Project
prompt_templates.prompt: /team-research Research an offline inventory application for field teams. Prefer TypeScript and exclude proprietary databases.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when goals and technology constraints are known.

prompt_templates.title: Add User Experience Research
prompt_templates.prompt: /team-research Research a patient scheduling portal using --deep. Compare accessibility patterns, architecture options, and established competitors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when user experience evidence must inform technical choices.

prompt_templates.title: Control Sources and Output
prompt_templates.prompt: /team-research Evaluate a secure internal knowledge base using existing project documents, --no-context7, and --stdout. Cross-check conflicting recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for advanced research with explicit context, source, and output controls.

output_examples.input: Research an offline inventory application for field technicians.
output_examples.output: A dated report compares storage technologies, offline synchronization patterns, competing products, recommended combinations, risks, and cited sources.

output_examples.input: Deeply research a patient scheduling portal with accessibility requirements.
output_examples.output: The report combines stack, architecture, market, and user experience findings, then presents primary and alternative recommendations with evidence.

best_practices: Provide the project goal, target users, technology preferences, exclusions, and special research questions.
Choose quick for early screening and deep when user experience research affects the decision.
Review cited sources and validate recommendations against budget, compliance, security, and operational constraints.
anti_patterns: Do not include API keys, passwords, private credentials, or unrelated confidential data.
Do not treat generated recommendations as approved architecture or purchasing decisions.
Do not request deep research before defining the project goal and target users.

faq.question: What research areas does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers technology stacks, architecture patterns, competitors, constraints, and optional user experience trends.

faq.question: What does quick mode change?
faq.answer: Quick mode uses the core technology, architecture, and market researchers for a faster initial survey.

faq.question: When should I use deep mode?
faq.answer: Use deep mode when user experience trends and interface framework choices materially affect the project.

faq.question: Is Context7 required?
faq.answer: No. The skill skips Context7 when unavailable or disabled and relies on other research sources.

faq.question: Does the skill change project code?
faq.answer: No. It performs research and produces a report without modifying project code.

faq.question: Where is the report stored?
faq.answer: By default, it creates a dated Markdown file under docs/research. The stdout option returns output without creating a file.
